glossary.definition: (1) "Compensation" means money, thing of value, or financial benefit. "Compensation" does not include bail, fines, or court costs.
glossary.source_title: Section 2923.04 - Improper organizational involvement with a critical infrastructure facility.

glossary.definition: (2) "Critical infrastructure facility" has the same meaning as in section 2911.21 of the Revised Code.
